item.text: The loader starts from `Default()` and applies keys that Viper reports as set. I found two details that affect the fix: `Default()` currently enables update checks, and `Load` uses Viper’s global state across calls. I’m addressing both so omitted keys retain the default and a prior load cannot affect a later one.
